R.name: Dragon's Descent
R.title: Template:Data Shyvana/Dragon's Descent
R.wikitext:
<!-- Damage values are defined as parameters.
-->{{#vardefine:fb1|0.5}}<!-- Base fury regeneration per second at rank 1
-->{{#vardefine:fb3|1}}<!-- Base fury regeneration per second at rank 3

-->{{#vardefine:faba|1.25}}<!-- Fury generation from basic attacks and abilities
-->{{#vardefine:dragf|3}}<!-- Fury generation modifier during Dragon Form AS A DECIMAL
-->{{#vardefine:min_mod|0.25}}<!-- Fury generation modifier vs non-champions AS A DECIMAL
-->{{#vardefine:calc_h|100}}<!-- Haste used in the calculations
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Dragon's Descent|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Shyvana
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|description  = {{sbc|Passive - Fury:}} '''Shyvana''' generates {{tip|Fury|{{as|Dragon Fury}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds while in {{sbc|Human Form}}. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} also generate {{as|{{fd|{{#var:faba}}}} Dragon Fury}} for each enemy damaged, up to once per enemy per {{tip|cast instance}} and increased{{ft|by {{ap|({{#var:dragf}}-1)*100}}%|to {{as|{{ap|{{#var:faba}}*{{#var:dragf}}}}|Fury}}}}during {{sbc|Dragon Form}}. Against non-champions damaged by abilities, the generated amount is reduced to{{ft|25%.|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:faba}}*{{#var:min_mod}}}}|Fury}} and {{tt|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:faba}}*{{#var:dragf}}*{{#var:min_mod}}}}|Fury}}|After applying the {{fd|{{#var:dragf}}}}x Fury generation multiplier while in Dragon Form}} {{as|Dragon Fury}} during {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Dragon Form}}, respectively.}}'''Shyvana''' gains 1% '''bonus''' {{as|Dragon Fury}} generation from all sources per 1 [[ultimate haste]]. '''Shyvana''' gains {{as|100 Dragon Fury}} upon learning ''Dragon's Descent''.
|leveling     = {{st|Dragon Fury Generation per 0.5 Seconds|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:fb1}}/2 to {{#var:fb3}}/2}}|Fury}}|Dragon Fury Generation per Second|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:fb1}} to {{#var:fb3}}}}|Fury}}}}
|icon2        = Dragon's Descent.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shyvana''' transforms into {{sbc|Dragon Form}} and {{tip|dash|flies}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location, breathing fire in a cone along the way that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|fear|fears}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, as well as {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% for the same duration.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
|description3 = {{sbc|Dragon Form}}: '''Shyvana''' gains {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}}, and increased {{tip|size}}. Her basic abilities are empowered to apply an additional effect. She maintains {{sbc|Dragon Form}} at a recurring cost of {{as|Dragon Fury}}, returning to {{sbc|Human Form}} once all {{as|Dragon Fury}} has been depleted.
|leveling3    = {{st|Bonus Health|{{ap|150 to 350}}}}
{{st|Bonus Range|{{ap|25 to 75}}}}
{{st|Size Increase|{{ap|5 to 20}}%}}
|description4 = ''{{tip|Fury|{{as|100 Dragon Fury}}}} is required to cast this ability.''
|target range = {{tt|400 - 1050|Minimum and maximum dash distance}}
|range        = <!--{{tt|X|Cone length}}--> 
|angle        = <!--{{tt|X|Cone angle}}{{degrees}}-->
|speed        = <!--{{tt|X|Dash speed}}-->
|cost         = {{as|{{fd|3.{{recurring|3}}}}|Fury}}
|costtype     = {{as|Dragon Fury}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = magic
|spelleffects = aoe
|spellshield  = True
|grounded     = true
|knockdown    = false
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* ''Dragon's Descent's'' {{tip|displacement immunity}} begins from the start of the cast time.
* Ultimate haste acquired while '''Shyvana''' is dead does not grant bonus {{as|Dragon Fury}} generation until she respawns.
* ''{{ais|Emberstrike|Shyvana}}'' attack against the primary target will generate the full {{as|Dragon Fury}} amount even if they're a non-champion.
** The attack's area of effect will generate reduced {{as|Dragon Fury}} for secondary targets damaged.
{{ct|cast|spells=true,false,false,false,false}}
|tips         =
* Because of how [[ultimate haste]] interacts with '''Shyvana's''' fury generation, it has a bigger effect than haste has on abilities with a regular cooldown.
** ''Dragon's Descent'' essentially has a cooldown of {{ap|100/{{#var:fb1}}|100/{{#var:fb2}}|100/{{#var:fb3}}|round=3}} seconds, reduced by {{ap|{{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb1}}*{{#var:min_mod}}|{{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb2}}*{{#var:min_mod}}|{{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb3}}*{{#var:min_mod}}|round=4}} for each damaging basic attack and ability hit, increased to {{ap|{{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb1}}|{{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb2}}|{{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb3}}|round=2}} against champions.
** It also essentially lasts for {{ap|(100/(10/3))/2}} seconds, increased by {{ap|(({{#var:faba}}*{{#var:dragf}}*{{#var:min_mod}})/(10/3))/2}} for each basic attack and ability hit, increased to {{ap|({{#var:faba}}*{{#var:dragf}}/(10/3))/2}} against champions.
*** Normally, with {{ap|{{#var:calc_h}}}} haste, the only effect would be the cooldown getting reduced by {{ap|{{#var:calc_h}}/({{#var:calc_h}}+100)*100|round=2}}% to {{ap|100/{{#var:fb1}}*100/(100+{{#var:calc_h}})|100/{{#var:fb2}}*100/(100+{{#var:calc_h}})|100/{{#var:fb3}}*100/(100+{{#var:calc_h}})|round=3}}, but because {{#var:calc_h}} ultimate haste grants '''Shyvana''' an extra {{ap|{{#var:calc_h}}}}% '''bonus''' fury generation from '''all''' sources, this also increases how much the "cooldown" is reduced by basic attacks and abilities to {{ap|({{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb1}}*{{#var:min_mod}})*(100+{{#var:calc_h}})/100|({{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb2}}*{{#var:min_mod}})*(100+{{#var:calc_h}})/100|({{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb3}}*{{#var:min_mod}})*(100+{{#var:calc_h}})/100|round=4}} for non-champions and {{ap|({{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb1}})*(100+{{#var:calc_h}})/100|({{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb2}})*(100+{{#var:calc_h}})/100|({{#var:faba}}/{{#var:fb3}})*(100+{{#var:calc_h}})/100|round=2}} for champions. 
**** This is the opposite effect to abilities with cooldown reductions that scale with haste (e.g. {{cai|Alpha Strike|Master Yi}}), which instead lower the reduction amount with haste. This happens because ultimate haste increases fury generation from ''all'' sources instead of only increasing her passive fury generation.
*** Additionally, this also affects the duration increase per basic attack or ability the same way, amounting to an extra {{ap|((({{#var:faba}}*{{#var:dragf}}*{{#var:min_mod}})/(10/3))/2)*(100+{{#var:calc_h}})/100}} against non-champions and {{ap|(({{#var:faba}}*{{#var:dragf}}/(10/3))/2)*(100+{{#var:calc_h}})/100}} against champions.
<!--blurb-->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive - Fury:}} {{ci|Shyvana}} generates {{tip|Fury|{{as|Fury}}}} every second while in {{sbc|Human Form}}, and also generates {{as|Fury}} from her basic attacks and abilities when they deal damage.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shyvana''' transforms into {{sbc|Dragon Form}} and {{tip|dash|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, breathing fire in a cone that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and briefly {{tip|fear|fears}} them.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|Dragon Form}}: '''Shyvana''' gains {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}}, and increased {{tip|size}}. Her abilities are empowered to apply an additional effect. She maintains {{sbc|Dragon Form}} at a recurring cost of {{as|Dragon Fury}}, returning to {{sbc|Human Form}} once all {{as|Dragon Fury}} has been depleted.
}}
